findings.blocks_because: a committed artifact of record contradicts itself; the published figures a reader takes as verified-correct are false
findings.claim: The repair republished ADR-019's band bullets to 153/155 and 58/60 but left the paragraph that summarises them still naming the OLD results, so specs/decisions/ADR-019-wall-clock-ceilings-per-suite.md now contradicts itself eight lines apart - the exact defect class R1-3 was raised for, re-introduced by the fix for R1-3.
findings.evidence: specs/decisions/ADR-019-wall-clock-ceilings-per-suite.md:92 'The `152/154` and `59/59` above are the cited rows' own results' - neither figure appears above it any more: :66 now publishes `fast` 153/155 (ts 20260824-083831) and :140 publishes `invariant` 58/60 (ts 20260824-083720), and the repaired sentence at :96-99 states those same two rows as '153/155 and 58/60'. Ledger rows confirm the bullets, not :92 (evals/report/history.jsonl:1245-1246). The same paragraph's dirty-by-construction rationale is stale on the same edit: :68-69 'takes the suite to 154 ... every run at 154 is taken' and :142 'the case that takes the suite to 59' against the 155/60 counts this branch actually ships.
findings.repro: grep -n '152/154\|59/59\|suite to 154\|suite to 59' specs/decisions/ADR-019-wall-clock-ceilings-per-suite.md -> lines 68, 69, 92, 101, 142 against the 153/155 and 58/60 published at :66 and :140. `published-band-matches-the-ledger` passes (its item 2 grades the bullet, not this sentence), so nothing catches it.
findings.acceptance: Line 92 names the two results actually published above it (153/155 and 58/60) or drops the figures and defers to :96-99; :68-69 and :142 name 155 and 60. Ideally the reference-to-the-bullet is graded, since this is the second round the same paragraph has gone stale under a republished number.

findings.blocks_because: two shipped comments state categorically something false about the code they annotate, and the accepted R4 fix is half-applied
findings.claim: R4's `isinstance` guards are half-applied and the comment they ship with is false: `plan_gap` still raises AttributeError on exactly the same malformed plans when the task is aggregate-shaped, and a non-dict step never reaches the 'loud rejection ... the executor's' that both new comments promise - it crashes `run_task` with an uncaught TypeError before `execute()` is ever called.
findings.evidence: src/browser/agent.py:299-304 asserts categorically 'A malformed plan is "no gap"; the loud rejection is the executor's, and unchanged', and src/browser/eval_adapter.py:360-366 repeats it. Both false in two ways. (a) The guard covers only the doc-root loop; the aggregate clause below it is unguarded - plan_gap('Which product on this page has the most customer reviews?', ['extract WebArea']) -> AttributeError at agent.py:319 (`reads = [s for s in steps ... if str(s.get("action") ...)]`), same for [None]. All three new truth-table rows are tagged PLAIN only (eval_adapter.py:367-369), so nothing could have caught it. (b) For a non-dict step the run does not reach the executor's TARGET_KEYS/unknown-action rejection at all: it dies at agent.py:1013 `read_only = step["action"] == "observe"` with TypeError propagating out of `run_task` (no status, no failure class). Not a regression versus main, so this is honesty-of-claim + partial fix, not new breakage.
findings.repro: .venv/bin/python -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'.');from src.browser.agent import plan_gap;plan_gap('Which product on this page has the most customer reviews?',[None])" -> AttributeError. End-to-end: any fixture case with stub_plan ['extract WebArea'] -> TypeError at agent.py:1013 out of run_case, not a classified failure.
findings.acceptance: Either the same non-dict guard covers the aggregate clause (one `isinstance` in the `reads` comprehension) with truth-table rows (AGG, ['extract WebArea'], False) and (AGG, [None], False) watched red first, or both comments stop claiming the class is handled and say what actually happens (uncaught TypeError in the step loop) and the residue is logged as debt with this repro.

findings.repro: .venv/bin/python -c "import sys,json;sys.path.insert(0,'.');from src.browser import eval_adapter as ea;r=ea.run_case(json.load(open('evals/adversarial/plan-lint-refuses-a-document-root-extract-midrun.json')));print(r['budgets']['replans'], r['got']['reason'][:80])" -> 0, 'the plan after the drill-down at step 2 was rejected by the plan lint'
